limitations: All natural outcomes are reused development, not independent confirmation.
Three seeds estimate optimizer variability, not participant uncertainty.
Shared representation bundles grouping, scaling and shared scoring.
Frozen voicing errors cannot be fixed by these pitch-only models.
The combined candidate misses the predefined natural-gain gate; one seed fails the post-change 300 Hz observation fixture.
No calibration, new browser/runtime measurement, temporal model or production promotion.

training_output_parity.scope: All stored emitted indices/states/Hz. Frozen index is -1 on unvoiced frames; ungated candidate argmax on those frames was not retained and is not claimed verified.
